pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition against adding positions (no grid or averaging down) within 120 seconds of a prior entry or inside an active high-volatility range expansion candle.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require volumetric and spread confirmation via order book imbalance metrics alongside a 3-period ATR envelope test prior to order dispatch.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate aggressive trailing profit lock-in via SENTINEL_PEAK_HARVEST once unrealized gain hits +$15.00 to prevent profit evaporation.
